runtime.name: omp
runtime.configuration: Hardened conflicting-writers fixture plus generated poteto-mode/feature Skills and native implementer role; cursor/default; disposable OMP agent directory with task isolation settings written and read back as enabled=true, apply=false, patch merge, and maxConcurrency=2.
runtime.permissionProfile: auto-approved root in a disposable Git repository with exactly two bounded isolated writable implementers and root-owned patch integration

assertions.evidence: The root used only repository-generated poteto-mode/feature Skills and the native implementer role.
Poteto-mode selected feature from the intentional maxBatch and delayMs behavior change.
Before any write the root named the same-file blocking gate, the two independent numeric changes, the shared mutable file, and strategy 1.
The root captured all four expected SHA-256 values before the single task call.
Runtime settings were externally read back as isolation enabled, apply false, and concurrency two; the actual task call recorded isolated:true on both items.
One batch task call started exactly BatchWriter and RetryWriter; no other child session exists.
BatchWriter.patch changes only maxBatch 10 to 25, while RetryWriter.patch changes only delayMs 100 to 250 from the same baseline.
Both task items used isolated:true, ran in distinct OMP workspaces, and left the parent checkout at the frozen baseline until root integration.
Both original writers yielded complete attributable results without retry, replacement, follow-up, or writer-to-writer hub calls.
The root inspected both retained patch files for their path and owned line before applying either.
The root applied BatchWriter.patch first, passed the batch check, then applied RetryWriter.patch and passed the retry check with the batch value preserved.
cmp reported byte equality and node verify.mjs combined exited 0 with maxBatch 25, delayMs 250, and matching c5840cc3...39402 hashes.
The root reported that native OMP implementer selection was available, so neither serialization nor inline-role fallback was used.
External Git inspection found only workspace/settings.mjs modified and git diff --check passed.
No commit, push, pull request, or other publication operation occurred.

limitations: This fixture proves two isolated patches against one physical file and ordered root integration; it does not prove arbitrary semantic merge conflict resolution.
OMP delivery remains D0 overall because the separate plugin-manager D1 gate is unresolved.
